controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.connection-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T08:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T12:00:00.000Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.11"
| STATS conns      = COUNT(*),
        bytes_out  = SUM(source.bytes),
        bytes_in   = SUM(destination.bytes),
        dest_ips   = COUNT_DISTINCT(destination.ip),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY destination.ip, destination.port
| SORT conns DESC
